purpose: Identify plausible weak-metadata candidates before library publication without relaxing recording checks

currentBoundaries.frontendSelection: src/lib/batch.ts resolveBatchSource rejects unaccepted assessments before enqueue
currentBoundaries.nativeAdmission: src-tauri/src/acquisition.rs selected_assessment gate runs before staging retrieval
currentBoundaries.recognition: src-tauri/src/autotag.rs songrec_match requires two consistent non-overlapping twenty-second excerpts and retains recognition without a catalog match

requiredBehavior: Separate explicit opt-in, disabled by default; existing post-download tagging settings do not silently enable staging verification.
Only plausible candidates with matching title and duration and no hard version/identifier contradiction enter verification.
Never fingerprint candidates that already have adequate positive recording evidence.
Retrieve into an owned temporary staging directory; no asset, file tags, playlist membership or library publication before verification.

Verification must establish the requested recording through a shared ISRC or an independently verified catalog crosswalk for the recognized recording, with compatible credits, version and runtime. Plain name equality alone is insufficient; unresolved identity remains review-only.
Bind recognition to the actual staged-file hash and selected provider locator; candidate substitution invalidates proof.
Reassess recording policy after recognition; no blanket confidence-score promotion.
Cancellation, timeout, opt-in revocation and unmatched identification stop publication and clean temporary material.
Do not silently retry fingerprint submissions or switch recognition providers.
Soulseek may need the full temporary transfer; stream sample retrieval is a later optimization and must not be claimed as implemented by staging verification.
implementationUnits: Snapshot explicit opt-in at enqueue; recheck it before any fingerprint submission.
Expose server-computed pending-verification eligibility to batch selection instead of duplicating permissive matching in the UI.
Introduce identifying state between staging retrieval and publication, preserving all existing admission, format and quality checks.
Factor two-excerpt recognition from optional catalog enrichment so recording verification does not depend on MusicBrainz availability.
Persist bounded verification outcome and file-hash binding; retain unknown outcomes for review without fabricating catalog metadata.
acceptanceTests: Strongly matched candidate performs no recognition.
Disabled opt-in retains existing strict behavior.
Weak eligible candidate is never published before successful verification.
Different ISRC, conflicting remix/guest, short or unavailable samples and inconsistent excerpt identifications refuse publication.
Exact requested ISRC plus compatible recording policy permits only the verified staged file.
A request without ISRC can pass only through an independently verified recognition-to-catalog crosswalk; absent or ambiguous crosswalks stay unresolved.
Cancellation and setting revocation at every wait boundary clean staging and publish nothing.
Source switch or staged-file change invalidates proof.
Soulseek and streamable-source paths report whether a full temporary file or bounded samples were fetched.
Use synthetic/local fixtures by default; real fingerprint qualification requires specific user authorization.
normalDataConstraint: Keep existing library, manual metadata, assets and sign-ins intact; runtime checks must restore paused state and every queue occurrence.

implementationProgress.recognitionBoundary: recognize_file_without_catalog now collects and checks two excerpt results independently of catalog enrichment; the existing post-download path uses it.
implementationProgress.temporaryExcerptOwnership: Each extraction owns a private temporary directory; cancellation during a real synthetic Unix extraction subprocess removes it. Windows cancellation remains unqualified.
stillMissing: Settings UI and live consent recheck before each fingerprint submission
Staging identifying state and publication gate
Catalog crosswalk validation and staged-file/source hash binding for the new per-excerpt evidence
Cancellation, revocation and cleanup coverage throughout the complete staged workflow
implementationProgress.proofCaution: The combined isrc field can still come from one excerpt. The staged verifier must use agreeingIdentifiers plus independently validated catalog crosswalks and staged-file/source binding; excerptCount alone is insufficient.
implementationProgress.perExcerptIdentifiers: AudioRecognition now retains agreeingIdentifiers only for ISRC/Shazam/Apple values observed with the same value in both excerpts. Legacy records default to no agreement evidence. Tag review labels explicit ISRC agreement.
implementationProgress.inputBinding: Canonical regular-file path and SHA-256 bind independently supplied requested recording and selected source, matching mode and stable locator fields. Existing registered-file tagging uses this component; staged admission/publication integration remains unfinished.
implementationProgress.consentSetting: Separate default-off downloadAudioVerificationEnabled preference and enqueue snapshot are implemented. No settings UI or staged verifier is connected yet; live consent recheck before each submission remains required.
implementationProgress.eligibilityComponent: Server assess_download_candidate returns identificationEligible alongside the unchanged flattened assessment. Title/runtime agreement, recording conflicts, extractor annotations, source permission and usable sampling duration are checked. Batch type understands the field but strict selection and acquisition gates remain unchanged. Three focused native tests and 19 batch tests pass, including the final duration bound.
implementationProgress.identifierLinkComponent: Requires explicit two-excerpt ISRC agreement and rejects conflicting request identifiers. Missing request ISRC uses revalidated exact MusicBrainz recording-row membership only, excluding release-wide ISRC lists. Four identifier/eligibility tests and a positive/negative catalog-crosswalk fixture pass. Title/credit/version reassessment and staged publication integration remain open.
implementationProgress.recognizedPolicyComponent: Verifier component combines identifier linkage with existing recording_match_context using recognizer title/artist and actual measured file duration. It requires accepted Exact/Probable relationship; Flexible alternatives do not establish requested-recording verification. Five focused tests pass, including shared-ISRC title/artist/version/guest/runtime contradictions. Not connected to staged downloads or publication.
implementationProgress.stagedEntryComponent: Owned-TempDir entry point now binds requested recording/source/file, probes actual duration, performs two guarded excerpts without retries and verifies recording policy. It polls live consent/cancellation, rechecks consent after extraction immediately before submission, and returns an in-memory recheckable receipt. All three local preflight, revocation and post-extraction submission-boundary tests pass. Not connected to acquisition; caller-owned staging cleanup and identifying-state recovery remain unfinished.
